messages.subject: Legend: Combine linetype and colour
parts:
Hi all,

 

first time I’m writing here but I can’t solve this one. Here is my code:

 

ggplot(data=emotion_time, aes(x = Time, y = value, linetype = Group, colour = Group)) +

  geom_line(size = 1.3) +

  geom_point(shape = 16, size = 4) +

  scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("#031926", "#468189","#031926", "#468189")) +

  scale_linetype_manual(name = "Legend", values = c(1, 4, 1, 4)) +

  ylab("Emotion") +

  ggtitle("Emotion by Time") +

  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

 

 

In the picture attached you can find the result. Everything is fine except the legend doesn’t show the dashed line. I know it has something to do with what I assign to what. I also have Variable for CS / ZM and Anger / Joy. I just can’t get the legend to look like I want it to.

 

Thank you

Bernd

You didn't provide a reprex, so I can't tell for sure, but my
suspicion is that the line in the legend _is_ dotted, but the gaps are
over the point so you can't see them.

Hadley
